highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: The release adds variable font and color palette support, animated WebP encoding, and zero-copy stream helpers. All bundled native dependencies are refreshed with security updates. This is a breaking release — legacy SKPaint text APIs are now compile errors, typeface defaults changed, and Vulkan 1.1 is required. Review the breaking changes before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: SKPaint text/font APIs removed — use SKFont
breaking.body: The legacy text-state properties on SKPaint (Typeface, TextSize, TextAlign, etc.) that were `[Obsolete]` since 2.x are now compile errors. Move typeface and text sizing onto SKFont and pass it alongside SKPaint. The remaining paint read-only state-inspection APIs (MeasureText via paint, etc.) are also gone.

breaking.title: new SKFont() typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty, not null
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. After upgrading, `new SKFont().MeasureText("Hello")` returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Pass an explicit typeface: `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`. Detect an unset typeface with `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of `== null`.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface is SKTypeface.Default, not null
breaking.body: Paint now seeds a default font eagerly. Text still works, but code that checked `paint.Typeface == null` to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires. Use `paint.Typeface.IsEmpty` or drop the null check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default (not null) for missing families on Android
breaking.body: All platforms now return SKTypeface.Default for an unknown family name. For strict null semantics use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)`, which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) throws OverflowException and is obsolete
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit; the long overload now uses a checked cast and throws OverflowException for out-of-range values, and is marked [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with an in-range offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan requires Vulkan 1.1 — process aborts on 1.0
breaking.body: Skia Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a 1.0 instance or leaving GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion at 0 calls SK_ABORT — the process terminates, not an exception. Set apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on VkApplicationInfo and set MaxAPIVersion on GRVkBackendContext. Genuinely 1.0-only hardware must use raster or another GPU backend.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative — five fields removed
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice have been removed from the interop struct. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures, and delete the others.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value equality; GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped
breaking.body: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable<T> and the == / != operators are removed. GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed as GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update any equality comparisons to field-by-field checks.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter for IgnorePublicDispose has been removed; the property is now get-only after construction. Subclasses that wrote to this property must set the value at construction time via the base-class constructor.

bullets.lead: Skia upgraded from m132 through m148 across four milestones
bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances from milestone 132 to 148, bringing upstream bug fixes, new rendering capabilities, and the font-engine rework that underpins variable fonts.

bullets.lead: Upstream chrome/m147 and chrome/m148 stability syncs
bullets.detail: Three rounds of upstream bug-fix syncs from the chrome/m147 and chrome/m148 branches have been applied.

bullets.lead: Variable font support in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp
bullets.detail: Variable fonts with axis variation (weight, width, etc.) and color font palette selection are now supported. HarfBuzzSharp gains matching variation and palette APIs.
New SKWebpEncoder APIs let callers compose and encode animated WebP files from a sequence of SKBitmap or SKImage frames.
A new GetData() helper returns the stream's underlying buffer as an SKData without copying, enabling zero-copy paths when reading from memory-backed streams.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions support added to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface
bullets.detail: Callers can now control the sampling filter (nearest, linear, cubic, etc.) when drawing one surface onto another.

bullets.lead: HBColor struct and missing API wrappers added
bullets.detail: A proper HBColor value type now wraps hb_color_t. Missing HarfBuzz API wrappers were added and naming-convention violations fixed.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrections
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan incorrectly used Width instead of RowBytes for stride, causing wrong data in padded images, and used Height instead of Width for the x/y offset calculation.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first
bullets.detail: When the garbage collector finalized an SKPathBuilder before its derived SKPath, the path's finalizer would crash. The ownership relationship is now correctly modelled.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: Passing a region rect to SKImage.FromEncodedData leaked a native resource when the crop produced an empty image.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution moved to the managed layer
bullets.detail: Android API 36+ no longer crashes when resolving SKTypeface.Default; the managed layer falls back gracefully instead of calling removed native APIs.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9
bullets.detail: Consumers targeting .NET 9 with WinUI no longer encounter a missing projection DLL at runtime.
The mechanism that keeps singleton SKObject instances (surfaces, contexts, etc.) alive across GC cycles has been redesigned to be more deterministic and less prone to use-after-free scenarios.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi constructor
bullets.detail: The check that validates native library compatibility now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor, making it easier to diagnose and handle initialization failures.

bullets.lead: Apple platform TFMs aligned to SDK conventions
bullets.detail: Library TFMs now use the versioned 26.0 form while app TFMs use the unversioned form, matching Apple's SDK conventions and fixing deployment issues on newer Xcode.
Native binaries for Linux Bionic (Android-derived Linux environment) are now included in the NuGet packages.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support
bullets.detail: The Tizen platform now ships native binaries for both x64 and arm64 architectures.
Native WASM libraries built against pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are no longer shipped, simplifying the package and reducing size.
libpng 1.6.58, libexpat 2.7.5 / 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, freetype 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0 are now bundled, picking up security and bug fixes from each upstream.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone bumps, variable font and color palette support, singleton lifecycle rework, SKPath finalizer fix, default typeface fix, SKPaint API finalization, and extensive Uno Platform sample improvements
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets support and PolySharp C# 13 support for legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Uno Platform SkiaFiddle WASM application size reduction
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Uno Platform README link and description update
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Android SKGLView rendering fix after tab switch in MAUI TabBar

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Opened the v4 line with Skia milestones m132 and m133, variable font and color palette support, Linux Bionic assets, Tizen multi-arch, and the SKSamplingOptions draw overloads.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData zero-copy helper, Apple platform TFM alignment, and the SKPath finalizer fix.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Security sprint: six bundled native dependencies refreshed (libpng, libexpat, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, zlib, HarfBuzz). WASM trimmed to .NET 8+ Emscripten only.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release-candidate finalization on Skia m148: pixel-span stride/offset corrections, compat-gate move to SkiaApi constructor, legacy SKPaint API removal, and WinUI .NET 9 fix.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 ships with this release, adding full variable font axis support, color font palette APIs, a new HBColor value type, and the HarfBuzz 14.2.0 engine update.
